summary: A row of menus, such as File, Edit and View. It is one stop in the Tab order.

root.note: A row of menu buttons. It paints nothing.

keys.ArrowRight, ArrowLeft: Move focus to the next or the previous menu's button, and wrap. While a menu is open, close it and open the next or the previous one.
keys.ArrowDown, Enter, Space: On a button: open its menu.
keys.Home, End: Move focus to the first or the last button.

guidance.text: Its menus are menu buttons the author writes inside it.
The author names the menubar with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

notYet: Menu items written straight into the menubar, with no menu of their own.
